Field notes on river gauges

River gauges record the height of the water every fifteen minutes, and the readings travel to the regional office where hydrologists turn them into flow estimates for the season.

The stations are old, and each one needs a visit every spring to clean the stilling well and check the float against a staff gauge painted on the bridge pier.
